items.note: Every DS background token was renamed by appending -color (they held only a colour and now feed background-color). Pattern: any DS token whose name ENDS in -bg gains the -color suffix. Covers all public --ds-<component>-...-bg hooks (avatar, badge, banner, button, card, date-picker, dropzone, empty-state, icon-button, input, modal, pagination, search, sidenav, stat, table, tabs, tag, toast, topbar) PLUS the globals --select-bg, --chart-hover-bg, --chart-tooltip-bg and the --status-<x>-bg set. Only DS tokens are affected — a consumer's OWN variables ending in -bg are not. When unsure whether a token is DS-owned, confirm the new name exists in the installed 0.3.0 package (themes/, styles/).

Every DS foreground token dropped the fg abbreviation for a SEMANTIC suffix — the replacement varies per token: text/titles/inputs -> -text-color; control & nav labels -> -label-color; icons/glyphs -> -icon-color. Examples: --ds-modal-title-fg -> --ds-modal-title-text-color; --ds-sidenav-group-fg -> --ds-sidenav-group-label-color; --ds-icon-button-fg -> --ds-icon-button-icon-color. Covers all public --ds-<component>-...-fg hooks (avatar, badge, banner, breadcrumbs, button, date-picker, dropzone, empty-state, icon-button, input, menu, modal, page-header, pagination, search, sidenav, table, tabs, tag, topbar) plus the --status-* and chart-tooltip globals. For EACH consumer-overridden -fg token, resolve the exact new name by looking it up in the 0.3.0 sources (themes/ + styles/ + component SCSS in the checkout or installed package) — do not guess the semantic suffix.

ds-stepper now renders the captions passed via [steps] as VISIBLE labels (previously screen-reader-only; only numbers showed) — a visual change for existing usages. Usually no code change: review that existing captions read well as visible labels; the new labelPosition input (bottom | inline, default bottom) adjusts the layout. Flag for visual review (eyeball).

informational: Reactive-forms (ControlValueAccessor) on ds-input / ds-textarea / ds-select ([(value)] signal API unchanged, both work) — additive.

ng add support (wires the global styles import idempotently); ds-combobox size input (+ComboboxSize); overridable focus-ring token system (--ds-field-focus-shadow / --ds-control-focus-shadow groups + per-component --ds-<comp>-focus-shadow hooks, default appearance unchanged); ds-tag hover tokens; --opacity-state-active overlay token — all additive.

Visual-only: tag close button gains a pressed state; accordion & sidenav-group animate open/close (collapsed content now stays in the DOM marked inert instead of being removed); ds-combobox focus uses the soft field halo; repo-wide value-preserving CSS modernization (background-color precision, modern hsl()/clip-path/range media syntax).
Fixes: ds-drawer closes on Escape when focus left the panel; ds-combobox 'No matches' row no longer selectable.
